tagline: International representation body for inland waterway transport and maritime safety
hero_kpi_rationale: The organization represents the interests of the European inland waterway transport sector and demonstrates active engagement through massive participation in its annual congress, reflecting the strength of its network and institutional influence.

kpis.name: Annual Congress Participation
kpis.explanation: Total number of participants attending the annual IVR Congress from multiple European countries.
kpis.description: 225 participants from 11 different countries attended the 2024 IVR Congress in Frankfurt (May 15-17), representing active members and industry stakeholders engaged with the organization.
kpis.signal: Strong industry engagement and institutional influence

kpis.name: Loss Prevention Colloquium Participation
kpis.explanation: Number of participants at the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium, the organization's first dedicated technical conference for loss prevention in European inland waterway transport.
kpis.description: 80 participants from Belgium, Netherlands, and Germany attended the inaugural Loss Prevention Colloquium in Antwerp (November 4, 2024), covering technical and financial aspects of loss prevention in European inland waterway transport with eight presentations across three sessions.
kpis.signal: Successful launch of specialized technical platform for industry collaboration

kpis.name: Member Geographic Coverage
kpis.explanation: Number of European countries represented in the association's membership base.
kpis.description: IVR represents members and stakeholders from 11 different European countries, demonstrating its role as a truly international organization for inland waterway transport interests across Europe.

kpis.name: Revenue
